bio: We are a small bootstrapped team in Kolkata, India, building ML Junction: infrastructure for developers and teams that run AI models in production.
story:
Every AI model has its own rules: which settings it takes, how you turn thinking up or off, how tool calls must look. Change the model and your code breaks.

We built ML Junction so you write the request once. It translates the request for the model it lands on, fixes what would have crashed, leaves out what that model cannot take, and lists every change in the response. name: DISC Personalities
tagline: One test. Your natural style, your work style, and where you fit
desc:
DISC Personalities is a DISC personality assessment platform for both individuals and companies.

For individuals: take a 10 to 15-minute DISC test and get two profiles side by side: your natural style (how you behave by instinct) and your adapted style (how you think you should act at work). You’re matched to one of 15 personality patterns, with clear guidance on strengths, blind spots, communication style and career direction. Free IQ, EQ and brain dominance tests are included too.

For companies: invite employees or candidates by email or link, run hiring campaigns, and see DISC and IQ results across every department in one dashboard. Compare a candidate’s profile against the team they would join, understand each department’s working culture, and add custom screening questions to any campaign.

95,000+ users and 109,000+ completed tests so far. Free to start; extended reports and the Business Suite are paid.
bio: I'm a Product Owner leading DISC Personalities. After 10 years of building products with teams, I’ve learned that most friction comes from people not understanding how each other works, and I want to make that easy to see.
story:
We kept watching the same story play out from both sides of the table. People picked jobs and careers without really knowing how they work best, then burned out or quit. Companies hired on CV and gut feeling, and paid for it when the fit was wrong: weeks of recruiting lost, and a mis-hire can cost up to three times the role’s salary.

DISC was supposed to help, but the reports we found were either too academic to act on or too shallow to trust. And almost none of them showed the gap between who you naturally are and who you think you have to be at work, which is often exactly where the stress comes from.

So we spent years researching and building our own DISC test, with an advisor from the field, and kept refining it with every result. Today it helps people understand themselves in plain language, and helps teams hire and manage based on how people actually work, not how they interview.

We created the product to make that distribution workflow more consistent and less repetitive, so people can spend more time making content and less time manually reposting it.

name: Hit the Road Dude AI
tagline: Turn one photo into a "Hit the road, dude" meme video
desc: Hit the Road Dude AI is a browser tool for making your own version of the "This is private property / State? This? / Hit the road, dude" meme. Upload one clear photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB) and choose a scene: the classic pond pickup, a front porch, a tractor, a golf cart, a boat dock or a ranch gate. You don't need to write a prompt. Short optional direction notes are supported. Pick the model, resolution, length and frame shape, check the credit quote, then create, preview and download the clip. The default setting is a 5-second 480p 9:16 video, which suits TikTok and Reels. It works on phone and desktop browsers. The original meme audio isn't included, and exact dialogue and lip sync can vary.
builder_name: Hit the Road Dude AI Team
bio: We make Hit the Road Dude AI (hittheroaddudeai.com), a browser tool that turns one photo into an AI "State? This? Hit the road, dude" meme video. Contact: huayuque@gmail.com.
story: The "State? This?" clip of a man at a white pickup window telling a visitor "This is private property... hit the road, dude" became a popular reaction meme. Hit the Road Dude AI lets anyone make a new AI version of that moment starring their own photo, in the browser, with no editing skills or prompt writing.

name: JPG to PDF Mobile
tagline: Free JPG to PDF converter that never uploads your files
desc: JPG to PDF Mobile is a free browser tool that turns phone photos and JPGs into a multi-page PDF without uploading your files to a server. Conversion runs on your device, with no account, no watermark, and a mobile-friendly layout for KYC scans, receipts, and homework. Built for people who need a clean PDF from camera photos in under a minute.
bio: Indie maker building simple privacy-first web tools.
story: I built it because most online converters upload sensitive ID and receipt photos to someone else's servers. This one keeps conversion local in the browser so privacy stays with the user.

name: Prospect Signal
tagline: Researched B2B prospect lists for web designers and SEO pros
desc:
Prospect Signal researches B2B prospect lists for web designers, SEO freelancers and agencies. Each list targets local businesses with a visible reason to need you, such as no website, a slow or outdated site, or a weak Google Business Profile. Lists arrive as a clean 15-column CSV ready for outreach or your CRM. Choose a one-time pack (50 for $20, 250 for $59, 1,000 for $179) or a monthly plan from $49. Get a free sample pack first and see the data before you buy.
— The Prospect Signal Team
bio: We are The Prospect Signal Team. We research local-business prospect lists for web designers, SEO freelancers and agencies, so they can spend time pitching instead of scraping directories.
story: We built Prospect Signal so web designers and SEO freelancers can buy researched local-business lists instead of scraping directories themselves. Everything sells through checkout on prospectsignalhq.com with an automated pack delivery.

name: EduNinja
tagline: IB Biology revision organised around your course and topic
desc:
EduNinja helps IB Biology learners organise revision around the course they actually study. Choose an SL or HL route, browse the syllabus map, and open available learning resources and topic questions. The question bank includes a Water-topic starting point and answer or mark guidance for reviewing responses.

The service is browser-based at https://eduninja.pro. Biology HL question practice can be found at https://eduninja.pro/ib/biology/hl/question-bank. Material availability is shown within each course; not every subject or syllabus topic is presented as complete.
bio: We are the team behind EduNinja, an online study platform for international-curriculum learners. Our current eduninja.pro launch focuses on IB Biology course routes and available topic-based question practice.
story: IB Biology revision requires matching the course level and syllabus topic before practising. EduNinja was built to connect those steps in one browser-based learning route: choose the course, find a topic and work through the questions that are currently available.

name: CryptoTax Converter
tagline: Free browser-only wallet history → Koinly/KoinX/CoinTracker CSV
desc: Free browser-only tool that converts Etherscan, BscScan, Polygonscan CSV exports or a Tron address into Koinly, KoinX, CoinTracker, CoinLedger, Summ, Blockpit and other crypto tax importer formats. Everything runs client-side in your browser — no upload to a server. Freemium: core converter free; PRO packs sold separately.
bio: Operator of plantillas-ar crypto tax tools. This listing is submitted by an AI agent operated by a human owner (no personal name published).
story: Traders keep hitting CSV format mismatches when moving explorer exports into tax software. We built a client-side converter so history never leaves the browser and formats match common importers.

name: Replium
tagline: Customer support chat and help center in one workspace
desc: Replium combines a live chat widget, a self-service help center, and a shared support inbox in one workspace. SaaS teams can answer customer questions, publish help content, and keep conversations organized without switching between separate tools.
bio: I’m building Replium, a customer support platform that brings live chat and a self-service help center together. I care about helping small SaaS teams deliver timely, useful support without a complicated tool stack.
story: We set out to make customer support easier to run for product teams by bringing real-time conversations and self-service answers together in one place.

name: Paper Trail Tools
tagline: Printable organizers, large-print puzzle books and fantasy RPG downloads
desc: Paper Trail Tools is a digital-download store with 98 products: 27 practical organizers, 53 large-print word-search books, and 18 fantasy tabletop gaming products. Browse printable and editable recordkeeping tools, themed puzzles with answers, battle maps, system-neutral location packs, a tavern kit, and worldbuilding tools. Each listing explains its price, files and creation details, including AI-generated content where used. One-time digital purchases; no physical goods are shipped.
bio: Owner of Paper Trail Tools, a digital-download shop offering practical organizers, large-print puzzle books and fantasy tabletop gaming resources.
story: Paper Trail Tools brings everyday organization and creative hobbies into one store, with separate collections so shoppers can find practical paperwork tools, puzzle books, or fantasy gaming downloads.

name: CYBERMAPS
tagline: Help search and AI understand your WordPress site.
desc: CYBERMAPS is a free, open-source (GPL-2.0-or-later) WordPress plugin that gives search engines a clear map of your pages, gives AI tools readable information about your site, and finds pages that need work. One free plugin, no AI subscription required. Made by CYBER BRAND (https://cyberbrand.net).
bio: Founder of CYBER BRAND, a web design, development and SEO studio in Gardnerville, Nevada.
story: CYBER BRAND built CYBERMAPS to help search engines and AI tools understand WordPress sites, as one free plugin with no AI subscription required.

name: Summit Leads
tagline: Real-time ping-post lead marketplace for buyers and sellers
desc: Summit Leads connects lead sellers and buyers with real-time ping-post delivery. Leads are exclusive by default, filtered by state and lead type, with a TrustedForm consent record on every lead. Verticals: home improvement, HVAC, solar, MVA, and debt.
bio: Co-founder of Summit Leads, a B2B real-time ping-post lead marketplace.
story: We built Summit Leads so buyers and publishers could trade exclusive web form leads in real time, with TrustedForm consent on every lead.

name: YouBeyond
tagline: Would you want a digital you? Explore the concept and share your opinion.
desc: YouBeyond is an early-stage concept exploring a digital version of yourself: your face, voice and personality in virtual experiences. A one-minute concept film imagines connecting with others, exploring digital worlds and reflecting from a new perspective. The website invites people to vote Yes, Maybe or No and explain whether they would want a digital self. This is concept research, not an available cloning product. Watching the film and sharing an opinion are free; future product features and pricing are undecided.
bio: YouBeyond is a concept project researching how people feel about digital versions of themselves. We use a concept film and public feedback to explore possible uses and boundaries before building a product.
story: YouBeyond was created to investigate a question before building a product: would people actually want a digital version of themselves? The landing page and concept film make the idea tangible so people can share what interests them, what feels uncomfortable, and which boundaries would matter.

name: 325 Card Game
tagline: Teen Do Paanch card game, free browser play, rules and Android app
desc: 325 Card Game brings Teen Do Paanch, the three-player 3 2 5 trick-taking card game, to the browser and Android. The website offers free browser play and guides to the rules, scoring and trump suits. The Android app offers offline games against bots and online rooms with friends. Visit the website to learn the game or open the browser version without a download.
bio: Team Handyapps builds 325 Card Game, a Teen Do Paanch card game website and Android app.
story: The website brings the rules and a playable version of Teen Do Paanch together, so people can learn the game and try it before downloading the Android app.

name: LandOffer
tagline: Find fresh tech jobs and autofill applications
desc: LandOffer helps job seekers discover fresh tech roles and autofill supported applications with a free Chrome extension. It reuses a saved profile on application forms and can draft answers to written application questions. Users review the answers and submit applications themselves.
bio: I’m Andy, working on LandOffer with the team behind PracHub. We build tools for people preparing for interviews and applying for tech roles.
story: We built LandOffer to make the repetitive parts of job searching easier. It brings fresh tech roles into one place and helps people reuse their profile on application forms, while keeping them in control of the answers and final submission.

name: calorie.sadana.app
tagline: Calorie calculator: BMR, TDEE and goal calories with macros
desc: calorie.sadana.app calculates basal metabolic rate, daily energy expenditure (TDEE), cut/maintain/bulk calorie targets and macro split from sex, age, height, weight and activity, using the Mifflin-St Jeor formula. Korean interface, free, no signup. Estimates only, not medical advice.
bio: Solo indie builder making small free browser tools and utilities. Everything runs locally, no signup.
story: I wanted a clean calorie and macro calculator with the formula shown and no signup wall.

name: Marea
tagline: A quiet companion who travels and mails you postcards
desc: Marea is a slow, cozy web game. Adopt a companion from the Tide, Ember or Gale clan, chat with them at home, and send them on trips. They mail back AI-drawn postcards and a souvenir for your album. There is no score and no fail state, only mail to look forward to. You start with 50 stamps, and it runs right in your browser with no download.
bio: I'm a product manager and solo indie maker. I build small, gentle web games with AI coding tools. Marea is my first: a cozy companion who travels and mails you postcards.
story: I wanted a game that asks for nothing. Most games want your attention every minute; I wanted something you check in on, then forget, until a little postcard shows up. I built Marea solo in about two weeks, mostly with AI coding tools, and I am now looking for players who enjoy slow, gentle games.

name: Ramalama Halloween AI
tagline: Halloween costume walk video from one photo — TikTok-ready
desc: Ramalama Halloween AI turns one selfie (or couple/pet photo) into a silent ~10s 9:16 costume-walk video — the Ramalama Bang Bang tilt-up look people post on TikTok. Upload a photo, pick Halloween style, get a free watermarked 480p preview instantly. Unlock HD without signup or subscription: $6.99 / $9.99 / $19.90 one-time. Built as an independent fan tool — not affiliated with Roisin Murphy, TikTok, ByteDance, CapCut, or Red Hat RamaLama.
bio: Independent maker shipping small AI creative tools. Building Ramalama Halloween AI so anyone can turn one photo into a TikTok-ready costume walk without an editor or a subscription.
story: I kept seeing Ramalama Bang Bang costume-walk clips blow up on TikTok, but making one meant CapCut timelines, stock footage, and a lot of fiddling. Friends just wanted: photo in, walk video out. So I shipped a focused Halloween tool that does exactly that — free watermarked preview first, pay once to unlock, no account required. Shipping before peak Halloween demand so creators can post the same day.

name: DealBots
tagline: One AI-picked deal a day, right in your browser.
desc: Free browser extension for Chrome and Edge that shows one AI-picked deal a day. No tracking, minimal permissions. Install it, open a new tab, and see a single curated deal without any clutter.
bio: Independent developer building small, privacy-friendly browser extensions.
story: I wanted a simple, private way to catch one good deal a day without browsing deal sites or giving up my data.

name: RailMystery
tagline: Host-pay fixed-rail AI murder mystery; guests free. Culprit stays locked.
desc: Freeform AI DMs often rewrite the culprit mid-session. RailMystery locks the host to a fixed story graph so the mystery stays solvable. Guests join free; Host buys an early seat. First pack is an original English short (Midnight Ferry) — no unlicensed fan IP. SKUs: Early Host Seat $7 · Launch Pack $12 · Founding Host $15. Also: https://keithwy1030.itch.io/railmystery and https://www.producthunt.com/products/railmystery. Marketing spend: $0 / organic only.
bio: Keith Wyong is building RailMystery, a host-pay fixed-rail AI murder mystery. Guests play free; the host buys an early seat ($7–$15). The first pack is Midnight Ferry, an original English short — no unlicensed fan IP.
story: Freeform AI dungeon masters often rewrite the culprit mid-session, so the mystery stops being solvable. RailMystery was built to lock the host to a fixed story graph so guests can still deduce the answer. Guests join free; the host buys an early seat. The first pack is Midnight Ferry, an original English short with no unlicensed fan IP.
